recovery.reason: Audit /root tmpfs filled; sole malformed final JSONL record. Audit was completed and final six-file output independently saved in stdout events.
recovery.recovery: Only complete original JSONL records retained in derived parsing copy. Original full bytes including partial last record archived unchanged. No reconstructed or invented records; no model rerun. Full original stdout events.jsonl remains unchanged.
recovery.limitation: Session transcript is incomplete from trailing write failure; not claimed as a complete session trace. All actual stdout tool events and completion are independently preserved.

campaign.stop_reason: Final permitted revision and fixed4screening/12confirmation completed; no harder evidence; two substantive revisions exhausted. Stop this candidate without extension.

original.timing_note: elapsed_seconds is the runner monotonic-clock duration. UTC timestamp duration is retained separately; large discrepancies may reflect host suspension/clock behavior and are not attributed to reasoning. Parallel session sums are not campaign wall time.

sol_retest.note: CLI reported token totals include repeatedly supplied and cached context; not a count of distinct source text. Concurrent run seconds are not campaign wall time. All recorded model attempts count, including faults. No GPT-6 sessions included.

historical_wqp_separate_ledgers.note: Separate historical work, not new construction during resume81. This inventory does not purport to cover every earlier project experiment.

limits: Missing elapsed and usage values remain unknown; known sums do not impute them as zero.
Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning output is a subset of output, never add twice.
Input minus cached input describes reported uncached input, not billed credits or weekly allowance.
Parallel session-hours sum is not wall-clock elapsed time.
Historical WQP campaigns are separate; only its user-designation control session159 is in this ledger.
This retrospective does not modify the stopped ledger, accounting snapshot, candidate states or evaluation protocol.
